The memo captures all the key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is an increase supplement that only contains:
- The loan amount ($25,000,000)
- The borrower (Texas-New Mexico Power Company)
- The new lender (CoBank, ACB)
- The administrative agent (KeyBank National Association)
- The dates (May 13, 2022)
- Reference to collateral (Replacement First Mortgage Bonds)

The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for terms like interest rate, maturity date, and payment frequency because these are not specified in this increase supplement document - they would be governed by the underlying Fourth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 11, 2022, which is not provided. The memo correctly captures all material financial terms that are actually present in the source document.
